about: The route to 17 December 2026, worked backward from the situations George must win. Episodes keep the outline in prompts/master_prompt.txt; this file says which situation each one rehearses, what must be won by each Sunday, and how the last ten days run.

session: Round 1 Drills (about 6 min): due cards and his own mistakes, spoken
Round 2 Conversa (about 8 min): today's situation as a role-play
Round 3 Ouvido (3 min): 10 episode lines at rising speed

where.Mon-Thu: episode on the morning train; Treino on the evening train or after the gym
where.Sun: the exam, then a light session

gates.note: He starts Treino on 14 Nov, so this gate slides: win these six by Wednesday 18 Nov.

gates.also: every earlier situation won a second time, with a twist
the toast, from memory, under a minute

dress_rehearsal.about: Days 35 to 44 and the three days after. Every scene runs with a twist, at natural speed, with the words hidden (Ears only). The Coach sets these as sys/plan.sit.

pace_check.mistakes: no mistake older than 10 days still open
